headline: On November 6, 2012: Tammy Baldwin becomes first openly gay U.S. Senator
captionCards: Paved the way for LGBTQ+ representation in national leadership
instagramCaption:
Tammy Baldwin made history on November 6, 2012.

She became the first openly gay person elected to the U.S. Senate.

The Wisconsin politician defeated her Republican opponent in a decisive victory.

A key detail: she was sworn in as senator in 2013, not 2012.

Her election paved the way for greater LGBTQ+ representation in national politics.
